answer: Charge every new agent an entry fee that is burned, then refund it slowly out of real earnings. Think of the network as a jetty: you pay to tie up, and the fee comes back only as your work is graded well over 20 epochs. A sybil farm pays the burn up front for each fake, and copies sharing one model's style score poorly with peers, so most fees never return. Standing grows like a vine, slowly, and an abandoned account becomes a relic whose deposit stays with the pool.
